justifications.read_only_justification: Reads connection and optional account-access checks. It may renew the supplied editing credential in memory, but does not change account records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, publish, or revoke account data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Optional doctor checks contact HighLevel for the connected sub-account. Editing-session renewal contacts the fixed authentication provider using the supplied refresh credential.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the fixed tool and workflow-preset catalog without changing it or accessing customer records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns catalog matches only; it cannot alter account resources.
justifications.open_world_justification: The open-world flag is conservative for this external-service integration. This search itself reads local catalog metadata and makes no provider request.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the current connection's policy for later tool requests, so it is not read-only. It does not change the HighLevel account itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only selects a session policy. Later account changes still require their own preview, target, and apply request.
justifications.open_world_justification: The open-world flag is conservative for this external-service integration. Policy selection itself changes only in-memory connection state and makes no provider request.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the sub-account and profile selected during connection. It does not switch accounts or change configuration.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reads the connection-bound profile only and cannot alter or revoke access.
justifications.open_world_justification: The open-world flag is conservative for this external-service integration. This operation returns the profile verified with HighLevel during connection; it does not make a new provider request.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks read access to custom values, calendars, and workflows for the connected sub-account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not repair settings, write records, or trigger workflows.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends authenticated read requests to HighLevel for the selected sub-account and reports unavailable permissions separately.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the connected location's profile, timezone, and configuration. Caller-supplied IDs cannot select a different account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, or delete a location.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the selected location from HighLevel using the credential provided during connection.

annotations.title: Compare a sub-account with a snapshot export

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares a supplied snapshot export with live custom values, custom fields, tags, and calendars. It does not save or apply a snapshot.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only computes a comparison. Omitted categories remain unverified and no account assets are overwritten.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the four supported asset categories from the connected HighLevel sub-account. The supplied export is comparison input, not authority to access another account.

annotations.title: Preview or apply a page change

justifications.read_only_justification: Supports reads and previews, but can also apply an approved preview to an existing page, so the tool is not read-only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Applying a preview can replace existing page text, styles, or content. It requires the same target and preview ID; checkout and upsell components must be preserved.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads and writes the selected HighLevel page using the supplied same-account editing session.

annotations.title: Save and check a site domain

justifications.read_only_justification: Can save a domain record and funnel binding after a preview, so it is not read-only.
justifications.destructive_justification: A saved binding can change existing domain or funnel settings. The preview and same-target apply request are required.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads and writes HighLevel domain settings and checks public DNS and HTTPS readiness for the supplied hostname. Private and special network addresses are rejected.

annotations.title: Build a workflow or call menu

justifications.read_only_justification: Can create workflow drafts and separately publish an approved workflow, so it is not read-only. A dry run alone does neither.
justifications.destructive_justification: Publication changes workflow and trigger state and can affect later form or call processing. Draft creation, publication, and actual execution are separate outcomes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the connected HighLevel sub-account's forms, tags, workflows, and routing settings. A LeadShield screening workflow requires a separately supplied site key and stores that key in HighLevel.

annotations.title: Check custom values and merge tags

justifications.read_only_justification: Inspects returned custom values and readable templates, plus optional supplied templates, for blank values and unresolved references.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not repair values, update templates, or send messages.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads available custom values and message-template data from the connected HighLevel sub-account. Supplied templates are audit input only.

annotations.title: Check phone routing and number pools

justifications.read_only_justification: Inspects available phone numbers, number pools, routing gaps, and forwarding loops. It reports missing access rather than inventing billing results.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not purchase numbers, change routing, place calls, or alter billing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the selected account's available phone and routing data through HighLevel. The sandbox has no Twilio account, so carrier-dependent results remain partial.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares staff assigned to the connected sub-account with a selected permission preset.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not assign roles, remove users, or revoke access.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads assigned staff and permissions from HighLevel, filters results to the connected account, and returns audit findings.

app_info.description: Preview HighLevel page and workflow changes, save domain bindings, and inspect settings for a connected sub-account. Review each proposed change before applying it, then verify the saved result.
app_info.subtitle: Review HighLevel changes

positive_test_cases.description: Check the dedicated Marketplace sandbox connection. Use context marketplace-sandbox only and verify the actual account readiness checks.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether our Marketplace sandbox is ready to use. Include the account connection checks, and don't change anything.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call ghl_agency_connection_health with includeDoctor true. Confirm the connected location is K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3. The hosted tool does not accept a context argument. Report the returned account and connection checks, including any missing access. Do not infer readiness from ok:true, a tool count, or a policy label. Do not access moosh-growth.

positive_test_cases.description: Find a supported funnel onboarding template. No customer account data is needed; results must come from the returned template catalog.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the available funnel onboarding templates and explain which tasks each one supports.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call ghl_agency_tools_search with query funnel and category onboarding. List only templates actually returned, with their names and supported actions. If none match, say so. Generic metadata without matches is not a successful search.

positive_test_cases.description: Inspect the dedicated FunnelLingo Demo sandbox location K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3. This is a read-only case. Reviewer access to the repaired hosted service must be established before execution.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Show the profile and timezone for FunnelLingo Demo in our Marketplace sandbox. Its location ID is K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3. Don't update it.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call ghl_agency_locations with location K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3. Return only profile fields and timezone supplied by the tool, and identify any unavailable fields. The hosted tool does not accept a context argument. Do not change the location or substitute a production account.

positive_test_cases.description: Audit merge tags in the dedicated FunnelLingo Demo sandbox location K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3. The repaired service must return actual audit evidence; a generic ok response does not pass.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Check FunnelLingo Demo, location K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3, for missing custom values or broken merge tags. Show the findings without changing them.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call ghl_custom_values_audit with locationId K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3. Explain findings and report the number of custom values and templates inspected. If both counts are zero, state that the audit cannot establish account-wide merge-tag validity. Do not claim a repair or use another location.

positive_test_cases.description: Preview a multi-step intake workflow in the dedicated sandbox location K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3. Do not publish a workflow, submit a lead, or trigger messages.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Preview a multi-step intake workflow named FunnelLingo Demo Intake Review for location K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3 using its test form bqXuxGwXUJhHXqqoLRU1 and existing tag 1x763LcIBaxUbsyX8ixw. Add a task to review the synthetic intake without contacting anyone. Show the proposed steps, but don't save or publish it.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call ghl_workflow_ivr_builder with locationId K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3, name FunnelLingo Demo Intake Review, formId bqXuxGwXUJhHXqqoLRU1, preset multi-step-intake, dryRun true, publish false, input.tags [1x763LcIBaxUbsyX8ixw], and an input taskTitle and taskBody for reviewing the synthetic intake. Show the returned proposed workflow steps and any blockers. If the form, tag, or editing access is unavailable, stop and report that limit. Do not call with dryRun false, claim publication, or trigger customer communications.

review_instructions.test_account_credentials: Use only the dedicated Marketplace sandbox credentials supplied in private portal fields. Begin Connect in ChatGPT and confirm location K7y1NkNaLMvf6l3ePSk3. Paste the supplied refreshable session JSON in the optional editing field. Never paste credentials into chat. A service restart requires reconnection.
review_instructions.data_safety_attestation: The service processes credentials and account data in memory and does not use them for model training. HighLevel stores changes applied through its APIs. Disconnecting revokes the connection; a service restart requires reconnection.
